Title: Able2Shell N-central zero-days - ipv4
Description: Source of 68 Able2Shell exploitation attempts against Previdian's N-central decoy from 9 November, including XXE and /etc/passwd reads, and host of the a.dtd and svc.xml payload files. Source: Previdian – N-able N-central critical vulnerabilities: what we know so far https://blog.previdian.com/n-able-n-central-critical-vulnerabilities-what-we-know-so-far/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.

Title: Able2Shell N-central zero-days - ipv4
Description: Source of 4EverAble2Shell probing observed by Previdian, including an attempted chain of Apache Axis CVE-2026-90436, privilege escalation to root, and a curl of a shell script from this address. No successful compromise has been confirmed. Source: The Hacker News – New N-central exploits work against patched servers, enable root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-n-central-exploits-work-against.html; The Hacker News – Recently patched N-central servers remain exploitable (X) https://x.com/TheHackersNews/status/2120834921241694544
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
